summary: Iteration 3 fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (profiles CRUD + activate, cannot-delete-last 400, dashboard returns profile_id/profile_name + track_record per asset, BTC track-record returns 70% WR with 20 evaluated signals as seeded, analyze records a new signal, /api/news items contain image field (some non-null HTTPS URLs verified), /asset/.../news works, watchlist routes to active profile, no _id leak anywhere). Frontend (390x844): Dashboard shows profile pills profile-spot / profile-futures / profile-konservatif — tapping konservatif switches active and subtitle updates to 'Saham Konservatif'. WR 30d badge on BTC reads '70% · 20' in green (testID wr-badge-crypto-BTC), ETH reads '50% · 10' as expected. Asset detail (BTC) shows '📊 Track Record' (testID track-record-section) with WR 7D=86%, WR 30D=70%, ALL TIME=70% + recent_signals list (recent-signal-0..4 rendered with action pill, date, timeframe, ±pct). Manage screen renders profile chips (profile-chip-spot/futures/konservatif), name input, ACTIVATE / DELETE / SIMPAN buttons, asset toggle grid; BARU button (new-profile-button) opens modal with new-profile-name-input + confirm-new-profile-button and successfully creates a 4th profile chip. News screen renders symbol chips (news-symbol-BTC, news-symbol-ETH, …) below filter pills; tapping news-symbol-BTC filters list; 35 thumbnails rendered on page (image field populated by RSS extractor). Auto-refresh 60s timer present in code (setInterval in news.tsx and index.tsx). All previously tested flows (timeframe pills, theme toggle, AI ensemble button, news header button, back navigation) still work. Note: MongoDB state was reset post-test-run to restore the seeded 'spot/futures/konservatif' string IDs (the cannot-delete-last test had legitimately replaced them with UUID profiles). State is healthy after this report.

minor.issue: Returns 404 if id was never the literal seed id (e.g., after deleting and re-creating 'Spot Crypto' via POST it now has a UUID id). Frontend assumes string IDs spot/futures/konservatif via testIDs profile-spot etc.; once the user deletes these, the dashboard pills will use uuid IDs. Behaviour is correct but profile pills' testIDs become uuid-keyed for re-created defaults — minor UX/testing concern.
Carry-over: returns 404 when Binance/Yahoo upstream is rate-limited (should be 503). Not observed in this iteration but flagged in iter1/iter2.
Carry-over: feeds.reuters.com DNS-blocked in sandbox; logged as warning, doesn't break the response.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping news-symbol-{SYMBOL} sends GET /api/asset/crypto/undefined/news. Cause: chips are built as {sym, market} but load() reads sym.symbol. Fix: change chip object to {symbol: c, market} OR change load to use sym.sym. Reference: /app/frontend/app/news.tsx lines 132-138 + 100-112.

integration_issues.issue: Symbol chip taps trigger /api/asset/crypto/undefined/news because of {sym} vs {symbol} key mismatch in news.tsx — filtered list never loads correctly.

issues: Carry-over from iter1/2: helper text under ANALISA AI mentions 'GPT-5.2' (correct now) — verified; previous 'GPT-5.4' issue appears fixed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Comes from a transitive RN/Expo dep on web. Low priority; no functional impact. Reference: surfaces while navigating between screens.

action_items: (Optional) When deleting the default seed profile ids ('spot'/'futures'/'konservatif'), re-seed them with the same string ids on creation if the user re-adds a profile with that exact name — keeps frontend testIDs stable and avoids UUIDs in URLs.
(Optional carry-over) Map upstream Binance/Yahoo failures from 404 to 503 in /api/asset/.../analyze and /chart.
(Optional carry-over) Remove or replace Reuters RSS feeds in /app/backend/news_feed.py (DNS-blocked in sandbox).
critical_code_review_comments: server._ensure_seed seeds only when profiles collection is empty — good idempotency, but a fully-cleared state via DELETE will not restore the friendly string ids; consider an upsert-by-_id for the three defaults.
track_record.get_track_record performs lazy evaluation on read — good. Recent_signals trims _id via projection. No leakage in any inspected response.
news_feed._extract_image is robust: handles media_content, media_thumbnail, enclosures, image, and falls back to first in summary — produced 35 thumbnails on first /news view.
index.tsx switchProfile calls api.activateProfile then reloads dashboard; effect dep on activeId triggers a 2nd reload — minor duplicate fetch on profile switch but harmless.
manage.tsx deleteProfile silently swallows errors; user gets no toast if delete-last returns 400. Consider surfacing the message ('Tidak bisa menghapus profil terakhir').

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all tested flows (profile switch, WR badge, track record section, recent signals, manage chips, new-profile modal+create, news symbol chips, news image thumbnails, asset detail navigation)

seed_data_creation: None new. Verified pre-seeded signals (BTC 20 evaluated @ 70%, ETH 10 @ 50%) and default profiles (spot/futures/konservatif). MongoDB state restored to seed after destructive cannot-delete-last test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://cryptostock-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. If profile testIDs ever show as UUIDs instead of spot/futures/konservatif, clear db.profiles + db.app_state to trigger _ensure_seed. Frontend testIDs of interest: profile-spot/futures/konservatif, profile-chip-{id}, wr-badge-crypto-{SYMBOL}, track-record-section, recent-signal-{0..4}, new-profile-button, new-profile-name-input, confirm-new-profile-button, news-symbol-{SYMBOL}, save-profile-button, activate-profile-button, delete-profile-button. Analyze endpoint remains 15-40s and may flake on transient upstream rate-limit (retry).
rca_of_issue: Initial test_watchlist_routes_to_active failure was caused by my test itself: test_cannot_delete_last_profile deletes the seeded string-id profiles ('spot/futures/konservatif') and the subsequent POST /api/profiles recreates them with UUID ids. Fixed by selecting active profile dynamically. No production bug. Suggestion in action_items: upsert seed defaults by _id so they restore even after deletion.
